# Privacy Policy for cast.onion

**Last Updated:** March 28, 2026

## 1. Introduction

cast.onion (“we”, “our”, or “the Service”) respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and your rights when using the Service.

---

## 2. Information We Collect

We collect only the minimum data required to operate the Service:

### Information you provide:

* Email addresses (when applying for a station)
* Names (optional or provided by users)
* Station names

### Automatically generated data:

* Session keys
* Access tokens
* Station keys

---

## 3. What We Do NOT Collect or Use

We aim to minimize data collection.

* We do not sell user data
* We do not use personal data for advertising
* We do not use IP addresses for tracking or profiling purposes

---

## 4. How We Use Information

We use collected data strictly to:

* Authenticate users and sessions
* Manage permissions and access control
* Operate and maintain stations
* Communicate regarding station applications

---

## 5. Data Storage & Retention

We retain data only as long as necessary to operate the Service.

We may delete or anonymize data at any time without notice.

---

## 6. User Responsibility

Users are responsible for any information they provide and transmit through the Service, including audio streams and station-related data.

---

## 7. Service Control & Enforcement

We reserve the right to:

* Refuse service to anyone, at any time, for any reason
* Suspend, restrict, or terminate access to the Service
* Revoke, disable, or remove any station

These actions may be taken without prior notice, especially in cases of abuse, violations of our Terms of Service, or legal requirements.

---

## 8. Third-Party Services

We may rely on third-party infrastructure (such as hosting providers) to operate the Service. These providers may process data as necessary to deliver their services.

---

## 9. Security

We take reasonable measures to protect data, but no system is completely secure. Use the Service at your own risk.

---

## 10. Children’s Privacy

The Service is not intended for children under the age of 13.

We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If we become aware that a child under 13 has provided personal information, we will take steps to delete such information as soon as possible.

This policy is intended to comply with the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA).

If you are a parent or guardian and believe that your child has provided personal information to the Service, please contact us at:
**[1500forlifejahh@gmail.com](mailto:1500forlifejahh@gmail.com)**

By using the Service, you represent that you are at least 13 years of age.

---

## 11. Your Rights (California Users)

Under the California Consumer Privacy Act, you may have the right to:

* Request access to your data
* Request deletion of your data

To make a request, contact us at:
**1500forlifejahh@gmail.com**

---

## 12. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time.

We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page. We may also provide notice via email and/or a prominent notice on the Service prior to the changes becoming effective.

We will update the “Last Updated” date at the top of this Privacy Policy whenever changes are made.

You are advised to review this Privacy Policy periodically for any changes. Changes to this Privacy Policy are effective when they are posted on this page.

---

For privacy-related questions:
